5. YELP 0 actionable / 2 marketing blasts. GOOGLE ADS 2 scheduled report emails, no disapprovals in the last 24h (PMax policy pauses from Aug 24 NOT re-verified). TRIPADVISOR nothing in 72h.

6. OPEN SPOTHOPPER TICKET: 'Google Ads conversion tag missing on sbbrewhouse.com' acknowledged Aug 24 -- conversion tracking may be under-reporting until fixed.

unanswered.draftReply: Donald, I'm sorry to hear you've been unwell and I'm taking this seriously. I'd like to look into your visit directly -- please reach me at the restaurant at (805) 884-4664 or mojobrewhouse@gmail.com so I can get the details. Food safety is something we don't take lightly, and I want to follow up personally. -- Joal, Owner
unanswered.handlingNote: DO NOT POST WITHOUT REVIEW. Public allegation of foodborne illness, now 17 days old. Recommend: (1) pull the Aug 8 lunch ticket and taco prep/temp logs, (2) notify your insurance carrier, (3) quick call with counsel. Never admit or deny causation in a public reply -- acknowledge, express concern, move it offline.
